text:
sara: Quick follow-up from the GPU capacity postmortem. We need owners + dates for quota guardrails, scheduler tuning, headroom runbook, and alerts. Can we close these this sprint?

miguel: I can own quota guardrails (per-customer burst caps, emergency global throttle, short credit bucket). Proposal by Tue EOD.

kevin: I'll run scheduler tuning experiments (bin-packing memory weight, affinity, preemption scope). Small perf sweep in staging, results Thu.

ashley: I'll draft the emergency headroom runbook: detection thresholds, comms templates, mitigation steps (e.g., route to quantized model pool). Draft by Fri.

dmitri: Ops automation: ops-bot will post daily snapshots and create a REM ticket when spare_gpus < 15% for two checks. Prototype alert next Mon.

jane: Product suggests adding a soft-rollout block: disable auto-rollouts when spare_gpus < 25% and require manual approval. I'll write requirements.

miguel: Guardrails idea: per-customer burst cap + 5-min credit bucket + admin override.

kevin: Quick config I'll test (pseudo-yaml):
```
policy:
  binPacking:
    weightMemory: 1.6
    weightCPU: 1.0
  preemption:
    scope: group
  desiredHeadroom: 0.20
```

sara: Reminder: Dedicated customers cannot be auto-migrated. Separate policy note required.

dmitri: Alert proto: `spare_gpus_percent < 15 for 10m` -> create REM ticket + ping #oncall.

miguel: Timelines: quota Tue (1957766400), tuning Thu (1957939200), runbook Fri (1958025600), ops-bot Mon (1958179200), fallback reqs Tue (1957766400).

sara: I'll open Jira and set a weekly reminder until closed. ops-bot?

ops-bot: reminder-created: "Headroom remediation weekly sync" every Mon 09:30 in #incidents. First run: 1957733400. (reacts: :white_check_mark:)

sara: Owners summary: miguel (quota), kevin (scheduler), ashley (runbook), dmitri (alerts), jane (fallback routing). I'll create REM tickets and tag owners. Close thread when tickets exist and initial proposals posted.

ops-bot: jira-created: REM-7301 assigned-to: miguel, REM-7302 assigned-to: kevin, REM-7303 assigned-to: ashley (links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REM-7301).
